entities.name: Query protein 495 aa
observations: Sequence length 495 aa; predicted molecular weight 52.14 kDa and theoretical pI 5.42.
Contains Mur_ligase, Mur_ligase_M, and Mur_ligase_C domains spanning the expected three-domain Mur ligase architecture.
Best reviewed homologs are MurE ligases with 51.9–54.0% identity and 91.9–94.1% query coverage.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: EC 6.3.2.13; catalyzes ATP-dependent addition of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate.
Requires Mg2+ for ATP-dependent ligation chemistry according to reviewed homolog annotations.
Participates in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis and is generally localized in the cytoplasm.
A conserved C-terminal meso-diaminopimelate recognition motif and N6-carboxylysine catalytic modification are reported in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: MurE ligation reaction
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE adds the third amino-acid component to the UDP-linked stem peptide precursor during bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan assembly.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Mg2+ is annotated as the required cofactor for MurE ligase activity in reviewed homologs.
